output.question: Thank you for describing the damage to the kettle lid hinge and the crushed box. Please send at least one photo of the damage (and the box if possible) so we can continue your return. Please also confirm a convenient time for the return pickup, as the courier's first attempt on 3 November was rescheduled at your request.

confirmed_facts.fact: Order ORD-2009 (electric kettle, Home category, AED 189.00) was delivered to the customer on 2026-11-01 at 12:00 (+04:00), signed by recipient.
The return was requested on 2026-11-02 at 10:10 (+04:00) for 'Damaged on arrival', 0.9 days after delivery; this is inside the 14-day Home window under Return v2.
The return pickup was scheduled, then attempted on 2026-11-03 and not completed; the courier note says the customer asked to reschedule. The parcel has not been collected.
The customer's later message describes a broken kettle lid hinge and a crushed box, and says a photo will be sent later. No photo is on file.
No warehouse receipt or inspection record exists yet, which is expected as the parcel has not been collected.

findings.description: The damage claim has a description (lid hinge broken, box crushed) but no customer photo. Return v2 2.3 asks for a description and at least one photo. The customer said a photo would follow. The request was made within 48 hours of delivery, but no photo has been received.
There is no warehouse inspection because the item has not been collected. Damage cannot be confirmed yet.

policy_references.quote: Home and other non-electronic items: **14 days** from delivery.
Without them, the claim stays open until they are provided.
Missing evidence is requested from the party that holds it (seller, courier, warehouse or customer). Never assume what it would show.

findings.rationale: The return is inside the 14-day window under Return v2 and the item price of AED 189 would be the refund amount if eligible. The damage claim is still open because no photo has been received and the parcel has not been collected or inspected. A draft request to the customer for a photo and a pickup time has been saved for a person to approve. A refund or replacement review should follow once the photo and warehouse inspection are available.
findings.uncertainty_note: Damage is described by the customer only. No photo, collection or inspection exists yet, so what the item's condition is remains unknown.
